title: Agent-skill scanners emit a 0-100 score on incomplete analysis

method.llm_analyzers: UNAVAILABLE — no API key; three semantic analyzers were skipped and the run is static-only
method.corpus: agent skills installed on one operator machine
method.reproduce: clone the tool, run the invocation above over any skill directory, read analysis_completeness.is_complete

finding.statement: Of n=12 skills, 12 received a numeric 0-100 risk score while analysis_completeness.is_complete was false. 3 were labelled HIGH or CRITICAL on coverage below 100%. The score does not carry its own coverage, so a reader cannot tell how much of the artefact was actually read.

why_uncheckable: A severity computed over part of an artefact is not a property of the artefact. This measurement reports the scanner's own completeness field and takes no position on whether any individual skill is safe. n=12 is below the n>=30 rule, so this is not a GSPC grade and enters no board.
not_published_here: Per-skill scores and names are deliberately withheld. Several skills are third-party, and an independent audit found YARA-based scanners flag ordinary MCP tool instructions as prompt injection. Naming a company adversely from an automated pattern match, before disclosure to that company, is not a measurement this estate publishes.
